CVE-2026-131857 [MCP]: Supergateway 4.2.0 through 4.2.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in stdio-to-SSE mode that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the gateway via prototype-inherited sessionId values. Attackers can send a POST message request with sessionId set to toString or constructor, triggering an unhandled TypeError that terminates every attached MCP session.

CVE-2026-130121 [MCP]: The AI Puffer - MCP Server for Claude & ChatGPT, with AI Chatbot plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via AI-generated comment replies in all versions up to, and including, 2.5.28 due to insufficient sanitization of the AI model's output in the insert_comment_reply_logic() function, which saves replies with wp_insert_comment() and bypasses the kses filtering WordPress normally applies to comment content. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an…

CVE-2026-123142 [MCP]: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.4 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user holding an MCP-scoped OAuth token to perform unauthorized issuable state changes on issues and merge requests, including approving and merging, due to incorrect authorization checks.

CVE-2026-130796 [MCP]: Flowise 3.1.3 through 3.1.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read MCP server bearer tokens via the GET /api/v1/public-chatflows/:id handler. Attackers can use the leaked mcpServerConfig token on the POST /api/v1/mcp/:chatflowId route to invoke chatflows, bypassing API key protection and consuming the owner's model quota.

CVE-2026-130837 [Cursor]: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read vulnerability in xmt_parse_mf_field() in loader_xmt.c caused by unchecked cursor advancement when splitting multi-value XMT-A fields. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file opened with MP4Box to make xmt_parse_string() read past the heap buffer and crash the process.

General ## Local Sandbox Controls in Enterprise Management Enterprise administrators can now set local sandbox controls for Kiro IDE and Kiro CLI. In Controls, require sandboxing for commands and local stdio MCP servers, and choose file and network defaults. Developers cannot turn off a required sandbox through client settings or change organization-set modes. Their allow rules cannot override organization deny rules, and tool permissions still decide which commands may run.
